title: US dollar dips as oil eases, yen jumps on Japan remarks

background.headline: Trump rejects Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal for Hormuz as Saudi coalition intercepts projectiles
background.summary: CNBC reported, citing the Wall Street Journal, that President Trump rejected Iran's conditional ceasefire proposal tied to the Strait of Hormuz, while a Saudi-led coalition intercepted incoming projectiles, keeping Middle East war-risk elevated heading into the weekend.
background.summary_ja: CNBCがウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルの報道として伝えたところによると、トランプ大統領はホルムズ海峡を巡るイランの条件付き停戦案を拒否し、サウジ主導の連合軍は飛来物を迎撃した。週末を前に中東の地政学リスクは高止まりした。

background.headline: Katayama and Takaichi remarks send yen to best day in two weeks near 157/dollar as oil eases 2% on Iran truce hopes
background.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said Tokyo "won't hesitate to take bold action" on the yen and Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi said she had told President Trump an undervalued yen was "problematic," sending the yen up as much as 0.6-1% to around 157 per dollar for its best day in over two weeks, while the dollar dipped and oil eased roughly 2% on hopes for a US-Iran truce.
background.summary_ja: 片山さつき財務相が円について「大胆な行動を取ることも辞さない」と述べ、高市早苗首相もトランプ大統領に「円安は問題だ」と伝えたと明かしたことで、円は対ドルで一時0.6~1%上昇し1ドル=157円前後まで買われ、2週間超ぶりの大幅高となった。同日、ドルは下落し、米イラン停戦への期待から原油も約2%下落した。

background.headline: Katayama says principles behind July's Japan-US joint yen intervention 'remain alive'
background.summary: Katayama said the principles underpinning July's coordinated Japan-US yen-buying intervention "remain alive," signalling Tokyo's readiness to intervene jointly again if renewed yen weakness warrants it.
background.summary_ja: 片山財務相は7月の日米協調円買い介入を支える原則は「生きている」と述べ、円安が再燃すれば再び協調介入も辞さない姿勢を示した。

background.headline: BOJ hikes policy rate 25bp to 1.25%, highest since 1995, in split 7-2 vote
background.summary: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25% in a 7-2 vote at its September meeting, the highest level since 1995, with two reflationist board members appointed by PM Takaichi dissenting.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は9月の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を0.25%引き上げ1.25%とすることを7対2の賛成多数で決定した。1995年以来の高水準で、高市首相が任命したリフレ派の審議委員2人が反対した。

background.headline: Fed raises rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, first hike since 2023, dot plot flags more increases
background.summary: The US Federal Reserve raised the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to a 3.75%-4.00% range, its first hike since 2023, with the updated dot plot signalling further increases could follow.
background.summary_ja: 米連邦準備制度理事会(FRB)はフェデラルファンド金利を0.25%引き上げ3.75~4.00%のレンジとした。2023年以来の利上げで、更新されたドットプロットは追加利上げの可能性を示唆した。

background.headline: OPEC+ core members hold October output flat after September's 188,000 bpd increase
background.summary: OPEC+'s core eight members agreed to hold October production at September's level, pausing further increases after having raised output by 188,000 barrels per day in September.
background.summary_ja: OPECプラスの主要8カ国は10月の生産量を9月と同水準に据え置くことで合意した。9月に日量18万8000バレルの増産を実施した後、増産ペースを一旦停止する形となった。

background.headline: Japan, US confirm rare July 31 coordinated yen-buying intervention, Bessent vows readiness for more
background.summary: Japan and the US confirmed a rare coordinated yen-buying intervention conducted on July 31, with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent saying Washington "will not hesitate to participate in further joint intervention" if disorderly currency moves resume.
background.summary_ja: 日本と米国は7月31日に実施した異例の協調円買い介入を確認した。ベッセント米財務長官は、無秩序な相場変動が再発すれば「さらなる協調介入への参加もためらわない」と述べた。

background.headline: BOJ holds rate at 1%, warns on inflation, same day as Japan-US joint yen intervention
background.summary: The Bank of Japan held its policy rate at 1% while warning that core inflation could exceed its 2% target, the same day Tokyo and Washington carried out their joint yen-buying intervention.
background.summary_ja: 日銀は政策金利を1%に据え置く一方、コアインフレ率が2%目標を上回る可能性があると警告した。同日、日米は協調円買い介入を実施した。

since.headline: CNBC: Hormuz tanker attacks hit wartime high as September Gulf oil exports still matched prewar levels excluding Iran, Brent near $105
since.summary: CNBC reported that tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz reached a wartime high, with the IMO counting eleven tankers attacked in the week to October 4 and five more the following week, even as Kpler estimated September Persian Gulf crude exports excluding Iran matched the prewar average and Brent settled near $105 a barrel on October 8 after rising more than 4% the day before.
since.summary_ja: CNBCの報道によると、ホルムズ海峡でのタンカー攻撃は開戦以来最多の水準に達し、IMOの集計では10月4日までの週に11隻、翌週にさらに5隻が攻撃を受けた。一方でKplerの推計ではイランを除くペルシャ湾の9月の原油輸出量は開戦前の平均と同水準となり、ブレント原油は前日に4%超上昇した後、10月8日に1バレル=105ドル近辺で終えた。

since.headline: Gulf of Mexico operators shut in about 25% of oil output as Tropical Storm Isaias approaches
since.summary: Reuters reported that US Gulf of Mexico operators had shut in about 25.08% of current oil production and 16.37% of natural gas production as of Wednesday October 7, 2026, as Tropical Storm Isaias approached, with personnel evacuated from eight production platforms and two rigs moved off location as a precaution.
since.summary_ja: ロイターの報道によると、トロピカルストーム「イサイアス」の接近を受け、米メキシコ湾の事業者は2026年10月7日(水)時点で原油生産量の約25.08%、天然ガス生産量の約16.37%を停止した。生産プラットフォーム8基から作業員が退避し、リグ2基が予防的に移動した。

since.headline: Pentagon orders CENTCOM to ready options for renewed large-scale combat against Iran; Trump has not decided
since.summary: Breitbart reported, citing Axios, that the Pentagon directed US Central Command to complete preparations for a possible resumption of major combat operations against Iran, with officials saying targets could include nuclear, infrastructure and energy sites; President Trump had not made a final decision and no date was set.
since.summary_ja: ブライトバートがAxiosの報道として伝えたところによると、米国防省は中央軍(CENTCOM)に対し、イランへの大規模な戦闘作戦再開に向けた準備を完了するよう指示した。当局者によれば対象には核施設やインフラ、エネルギー関連施設が含まれるとされるが、トランプ大統領はまだ最終決定を下しておらず、実施時期も定まっていない。

since.headline: September FOMC minutes show July 31 yen intervention's US side was funded via Treasury account, not the Fed's own balance sheet
since.summary: Bloomberg reported, citing the Federal Reserve's September FOMC minutes, that the New York Fed carried out the US side of the July 31 Japan-US joint yen-buying intervention using US Treasury funds rather than the Federal Reserve's own balance sheet.
since.summary_ja: ブルームバーグの報道によると、FRBの9月FOMC議事要旨で、7月31日の日米協調円買い介入における米国側の実施分はFRB自身の資産ではなく米財務省の資金を通じて行われたことが明らかになった。

since.headline: UKMTO: tanker off Qatar struck by multiple projectiles, agency urges caution transiting the Strait of Hormuz
since.summary: UKMTO reported that a tanker off Qatar was struck by multiple unidentified projectiles and advised vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz to proceed with caution and report suspicious activity.
since.summary_ja: 英海事当局UKMTOは、カタール沖でタンカー1隻が複数の不明な飛来物による攻撃を受けたと報告し、ホルムズ海峡を航行する船舶に注意しての航行と不審な動きの通報を呼びかけた。

since.headline: VLCC spot rate to ship US crude to Asia hits $77 million, nearly 8x the 2025 average, as Hormuz disruption persists
since.summary: Bloomberg reported that the cost to hire a very large crude carrier to move US oil to Asia reached $77 million, according to Baltic Exchange data, compared with a 2025 average of $9.2 million, as the Strait of Hormuz disruption kept tanker shipping costs at record highs.
since.summary_ja: ブルームバーグの報道によると、バルチック海運取引所のデータでは、米国産原油をアジアへ輸送するVLCC(超大型原油タンカー)の用船料が7700万ドルに達した。2025年の平均は920万ドルで、ホルムズ海峡の混乱を受けタンカーの海運コストは記録的な高水準を維持している。

since.headline: NBC News: at least 12 tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz in week to October 5, the most intense week of the war
since.summary: NBC News reported that maritime security trackers counted at least 12 attacks on oil, LNG and LPG tankers around the Strait of Hormuz in the week of September 28 to October 5, 2026, the most intense week for such attacks since the Iran war began, even as oil exports from the region have risen.
since.summary_ja: NBCニュースの報道によると、海事セキュリティー調査機関の集計で、2026年9月28日から10月5日の週にホルムズ海峡周辺で原油・LNG・LPGタンカーへの攻撃が少なくとも12件発生した。これはイラン戦争開始以降で最も攻撃が激しかった週であり、同地域からの原油輸出は増加しているという。

since.headline: Hormuz vessel transit collapses to 5% of pre-crisis traffic even as non-Iran Mideast oil exports top pre-war levels
since.summary: CNBC reported, citing maritime tracker Kpler, that commercial transit through the Strait of Hormuz fell to about 5% of pre-crisis levels on October 4 (four vessels versus a typical 85 per day), even as Middle East oil exports excluding Iran surpassed pre-war levels over the preceding week despite continued tanker attacks.
since.summary_ja: CNBCが海事データ企業Kplerの情報として報じたところによると、ホルムズ海峡の商業船舶の通航量は10月4日時点で危機前の約5%(通常85隻に対し4隻)まで落ち込んだ一方、タンカー攻撃が続く中でもイラン産を除く中東の石油輸出は前週に開戦前の水準を上回った。

since.headline: Tanker On Peace struck by projectile off Oman's Musandam coast, injuring 12 crew including 11 Indian nationals
since.summary: A projectile struck the Panama-flagged tanker On Peace near the Strait of Hormuz off Oman's Musandam Governorate on October 6, 2026, starting a fire and injuring 12 of the vessel's crew, 11 of them Indian nationals; Omani authorities evacuated the injured to Khasab for treatment.
since.summary_ja: 2026年10月6日、オマーンのムサンダム州沖、ホルムズ海峡付近でパナマ船籍のタンカー「On Peace」が飛来物の直撃を受け火災が発生し、乗組員12人(うち11人がインド人)が負傷した。オマーン当局は負傷者をハサブへ搬送し治療を行った。

since.headline: Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser warns global oil stockpiles are 'scarily thin'
since.summary: Saudi Aramco chief executive Amin Nasser said global oil stockpiles are 'scarily thin,' a remark reported by Bloomberg amid the continuing Strait of Hormuz disruption to oil shipping.
since.summary_ja: サウジアラムコのアミン・ナーセルCEOは、世界の石油在庫が「恐ろしく薄い」状態にあると述べた。ホルムズ海峡の混乱が原油輸送に影響を及ぼし続ける中でのブルームバーグへの発言である。

since.headline: UKMTO logs four tanker strikes in Strait of Hormuz over October 3-5, latest ignites engine-room fire
since.summary: UKMTO reported four separate tanker strikes by unknown projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz between October 3 and 5: a crude oil tanker struck above the waterline on October 3, an inbound LPG tanker hit at 1716 UTC and a crude oil tanker hit at 1907 UTC on October 4, and another tanker struck at 1637 UTC on October 5 that caught fire in its engine room, which the crew was fighting.
since.summary_ja: UKMTOの報告によると、10月3日から5日にかけてホルムズ海峡でタンカー4隻が不明の飛来物に相次いで被弾した。10月3日には原油タンカー1隻が喫水線上部を被弾し、10月4日にはLPGタンカーが協定世界時16時16分、原油タンカーが同19時07分に被弾、10月5日には別の船舶が同16時37分に被弾し機関室で火災が発生、乗組員が消火活動を行っている。

since.headline: Iran's IRGC orders inbound tanker near Strait of Hormuz to turn back or be targeted, vessel complies
since.summary: UKMTO reported that Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps hailed an inbound tanker about 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, Oman, near the Strait of Hormuz, and ordered it to turn around or be targeted; the tanker's master complied with the instruction.
since.summary_ja: UKMTOの報告によると、イラン革命防衛隊(IRGC)はホルムズ海峡付近、オマーンのハサブ北方約11海里の地点でインバウンドのタンカーを呼び止め、引き返すよう命じ、従わなければ攻撃すると警告した。同船の船長はこの指示に従った。

since.headline: Iran reiterates Strait of Hormuz stays closed until US meets its conditions
since.summary: Al Jazeera reported that Iran said the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until the United States meets Tehran's conditions, as the two sides continued indirect talks on ending the standoff over the waterway.
since.summary_ja: アル・ジャジーラの報道によると、イランは米国が自国の要求を満たすまでホルムズ海峡の封鎖を維持すると改めて表明した。両国はこの海峡を巡る対立の解消に向け、間接協議を続けている。

since.headline: NYT: US tightens naval blockade and sanctions on Iran as Hormuz oil flows recover despite weekly drone and missile attacks on shipping
since.summary: The New York Times reported that oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have risen even as Iran continues launching dozens of drones and missiles at commercial vessels there each week, largely unreported and often missing their targets, while the US has responded with a tightened naval blockade and additional sanctions on Iran as President Trump shifts the campaign from military strikes toward economic pressure.
since.summary_ja: ニューヨーク・タイムズは、イランがホルムズ海峡で商船に対し毎週多数の無人機・ミサイル攻撃を続け(多くは報じられず、命中にも失敗している)にもかかわらず、同海峡経由の原油輸送量は増加していると報じた。米国はイランに対する海上封鎖の強化と追加制裁で対応しており、トランプ大統領は軍事作戦から経済的圧力重視へと方針を転換しているという。
since.source: The New York Times (via The Philadelphia Inquirer)

since.headline: Iran confirms receipt of formal US response to its Hormuz/ceasefire proposal, delivered to Pezeshkian's cabinet
since.summary: Iran confirmed it had received an official US response, relayed through Qatari mediators, to its latest proposal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz; Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi delivered the response to President Masoud Pezeshkian at a cabinet meeting after returning from talks in New York, and the contents were not disclosed.
since.summary_ja: イランは、戦争終結とホルムズ海峡再開に関する自国提案への米国の公式回答を、カタールの仲介を通じて受け取ったことを確認した。アラグチ外相はニューヨークでの協議から帰国後、閣議でペゼシュキアン大統領にこの回答を伝達したが、内容は明らかにされなかった。

since.headline: CNN analysis: Iran's Hormuz leverage fading as oil flows recover to two-thirds of pre-war levels, IMF sees economy shrinking over 5%
since.summary: A CNN analysis by former senior US official Brett McGurk said Iran's leverage from disrupting shipping in the Strait of Hormuz is dissipating as a renewed US blockade and protection of commercial vessels have restored oil flows to about two-thirds of pre-war levels, citing IMF projections that Iran's economy will contract more than 5% this year with inflation approaching 70%.
since.summary_ja: 元米政府高官ブレット・マガーク氏によるCNNの分析記事は、米国による封鎖の再強化と商船護衛により、ホルムズ海峡経由の原油輸送量が開戦前の約3分の2まで回復する中、同海峡での船舶妨害を通じたイランのレバレッジは弱まりつつあると指摘した。IMFの予測では、イラン経済は今年5%超のマイナス成長となり、インフレ率は70%近くに達する見通しだという。

since.headline: Katayama repeats warning that undervalued yen is 'problematic' after phone call with Bessent
since.summary: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the yen's undervaluation remains a concern and that Tokyo and Washington will stay in close contact to keep currency markets orderly, following her phone call with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
since.summary_ja: 片山さつき財務相は、円安は引き続き問題だとの認識を示し、外国為替市場の秩序維持へ日米で緊密な連絡を続ける考えを示した。ベッセント米財務長官との電話協議を受けた発言である。

since.headline: Iran's Araghchi meets Qatari mediators in New York, says US may respond to Hormuz proposal by Tuesday
since.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met Qatari mediators in New York to relay Iran's amended Strait of Hormuz reopening proposal, saying he hoped for Washington's final response by Tuesday, while a US official said there would be no end-of-war agreement unless Iran's nuclear programme is addressed.
since.summary_ja: イランのアラグチ外相はニューヨークでカタール仲介団と会談し、ホルムズ海峡再開に関する修正提案を伝え、火曜日までに米国から最終回答を得たいとの見通しを示した。米当局者は、イランの核開発計画への対応なしに終戦合意はないと述べた。

since.headline: US officials say Hormuz oil flows near prewar levels despite Iran's claims of successful strikes
since.summary: US officials said oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz have recovered substantially despite Iran's claims of successful attacks on shipping there, with the Energy Secretary citing about 13 million barrels a day and the Treasury Secretary citing an estimate of 15-22 million barrels a day, against roughly 20 million barrels a day before the war.
since.summary_ja: イランが同海峡付近での船舶攻撃の成功を主張する一方、米当局者はホルムズ海峡の原油輸送量が開戦前の水準に近づいていると述べた。米エネルギー長官は日量約1300万バレル、米財務長官は日量1500万~2200万バレルとの見方を示し、開戦前の日量約2000万バレルと比較した。

since.headline: Iran's army vows to keep blocking vessels near the Strait of Hormuz as Tehran says it is "fully prepared" for war
since.summary: An Iranian army deputy coordinator said Iranian forces are acting with authority in the northern Arabian Sea and east of the Strait of Hormuz and "will not let anyone pass," while Tehran said it remains open to "real diplomacy" but is fully prepared for war.
since.summary_ja: イラン軍副調整官は、イラン軍がアラビア海北部およびホルムズ海峡東方で権限を行使しており「誰も通過させない」と述べた。テヘラン側は「本物の外交」には引き続き前向きだとしつつ、戦争への備えは万全だとした。

since.headline: Dollar index climbs to around 101.15, on track for best month since June, as yen slips to 157.7 and Brent holds above $106
since.summary: The dollar index edged up to about 101.15, on track for a 1.7% gain in September, its best month since June, as the yen weakened 0.3% to 157.7 per dollar and Brent crude held above $106 a barrel, with hawkish Federal Reserve rate-hike bets and the US-Iran Hormuz standoff both supporting the dollar.
since.summary_ja: ドル指数は101.15程度まで上昇し、9月は1.7%高と6月以来最も良い月間成績となる見通しとなった。円は0.3%安の1ドル=157.7円まで下落し、ブレント原油は106ドル超を維持した。FRBの利上げ観測強まりと米イラン間のホルムズ海峡を巡る対立の双方がドルを支えた。

since.headline: Brent rebounds above $106, up over 1%, after Trump rejects Iran's Hormuz reopening proposal
since.summary: Brent crude rose more than 1%, back above $106 a barrel, after President Trump rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, reviving concern that restoration of oil flows through the waterway would be delayed.
since.summary_ja: トランプ大統領がホルムズ海峡再開を巡るイランの提案を拒否したことを受け、ブレント原油は1%超上昇し1バレル106ドル台を回復した。同海峡経由の原油輸送再開の遅れへの懸念が再燃した。

since.headline: Yen extends Friday's rally into thin Monday Asia trade as fresh Hormuz missile report sharpens risk
since.summary: The yen extended Friday's gains into thin Monday Asia trading, with risk sentiment further sharpened by a report from Iranian media of a missile fired at a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz.
since.summary_ja: 円は金曜日の上昇分を維持し、薄商いとなった月曜アジア時間も堅調に推移した。イラン国営メディアがホルムズ海峡での船舶へのミサイル発射を報じたことで、リスク心理は一段と敏感になった。

since.headline: Trump tells Axios he expects US-Iran talks to resume this week despite rejecting Tehran's truce plan
since.summary: Trump told Axios he expects US-Iran talks to resume this week, even as he rejected Iran's seven-day truce proposal tied to reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
since.summary_ja: トランプ氏はAxiosに対し、ホルムズ海峡再開を条件とするイランの7日間停戦案は拒否したものの、今週中に米イラン協議が再開する見通しだと語った。

since.headline: Iranian FM Araghchi says Tehran is ready for a "doomsday" war with the US but keeps diplomacy open
since.summary: In an interview aired Sunday, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Iran is prepared for a "doomsday" war with the United States after Trump rejected Tehran's seven-day Hormuz reopening proposal, while stressing Iran will not miss any chance for peace.
since.summary_ja: 日曜に放送されたインタビューで、イランのアラグチ外相は、トランプ大統領がテヘラン側のホルムズ海峡再開に向けた7日間停戦案を拒否したことを受け、米国との「終末的な」戦争に備えていると述べた一方、和平の機会は逃さない考えを強調した。
